builder_plan.scenario: You already need task-specific training and want to reduce its memory or compute cost.
builder_plan.change: Change only the training technique on a small controlled run after checking prerequisites.
builder_plan.baseline: Your current training recipe with the same model, data split, and evaluation.
steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Held-out quality, peak memory, training time, and full compute cost to the target quality.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: Agent-R$^2$: Scaling Agents for Realistic Productivity Work via Real-Source Data Synthesis
summary: This method replaces manually specified workflows or LLM-generated files with a real-source data synthesis framework grounded in real occupational seeds and web-sourced files. It costs significant infrastructure to execute the data distillation pipeline and the subsequent supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning. It can fail if the specific web-corpus candidates do not generalize to the user's domain or if the rubric-based evaluation introduces biases.
rationale: While the data efficiency is high, the requirement for reinforcement learning infrastructure and specific data curation pipelines exceeds the reader's current constrained production environment.
technique: Real-source data synthesis for agentic post-training

claims.statement: This method replaces manually specified workflows or LLM-generated files with a real-source data synthesis framework grounded in real occupational seeds and web-sourced files. It costs significant infrastructure to execute the data distillation pipeline and the subsequent supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning. It can fail if the specific web-corpus candidates do not generalize to the user's domain or if the rubric-based evaluation introduces biases.
Trained on only 4k instances, Agent-R$^2$-4B surpasses Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 on both GDPval (51.0\% vs. 48.0\%) and OfficeQA (14.8\% vs. 13.8\%).
